description: Find VPS/VDS (or shared hosting, dedicated) plans across 2,000+ hosts by country, RAM/CPU/disk minimums, disk type, monthly budget, payment method, hourly billing and task presets. Returns 10 plans per page, cheapest first by default, each with specs, monthly price, payment methods, the host page and an order link. Prices are read on the hosts' own sites and refreshed hourly.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of server locations (any of them), e.g. ["DE","NL"].

disk_type.description: ssd = SSD or NVMe, nvme = NVMe only, hdd.

host.description: Only this host (slug, domain or name).

hourly.description: Only plans billed by the hour.

kind.description: vps, hosting (shared web hosting) or dedicated servers.

landing.description: Slug of a ready-made selection whose filter to use, e.g. "for-docker", "germany", "nvme-netherlands", "pay-with-sbp", "web-hosting-wordpress". Explicit arguments override it.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.

max_price.description: Maximum price per month in the locale currency (RUB for ru, USD for en, EUR for de/es/pt, TRY for tr).

one_per_host.description: At most one plan per host.

options.description: Required features (all of them): ipv6, ddos, trial, moneyback, smtp (port 25), api, instant, gpu, win_license, panel, no_kyc, ru_support, rub.

os.description: linux, windows, freebsd, iso (own ISO image).

payment.description: Accepted payment methods (any of them): card_ru (Russian MIR card), sbp, card_world (non-Russian card), crypto, yoomoney, webmoney, paypal, invoice.

region.description: abroad = outside Russia, eu, cis, asia, america.

sort.description: price, price_desc, ram_value (cheapest per GB RAM), cpu_value (per core), disk_value (per GB disk), ram, disk, ghz.

task.description: Preset filter for a typical job: vpn (corporate VPN), site, bot, games, windows, docker, storage, proxy, parsing, db, mail, dev, ai, or a game server (game-minecraft, game-cs2, game-rust…).

text.description: Free text over plan and host names, e.g. "ryzen", "timeweb nvme".

name: search_vps
title: Search VPS plans
